layers.name: Capability
layers.role: Set the direction: what should people and institutions be able to do independently?
layers.down: Capability objectives guide public priorities and investment.
layers.up: Evidence from communities and institutions changes future objectives.

layers.name: Governance
layers.role: Define responsibility, decision rights, safeguards and accountability for technological change.
layers.down: Governance translates objectives into accountable decisions and safeguards.
layers.up: Practical results and public needs inform better rules and oversight.

layers.name: Institutions
layers.role: Give programmes a durable home: organisations, people, resources and delivery capacity.
layers.down: Institutions organise access, resources, quality and sustained education.
layers.up: Delivery experience exposes gaps in resources, mandates and governance.

layers.name: Academy
layers.role: Connect schools, higher education and lifelong learning with practical understanding and demonstrable competence.
layers.down: Education turns institutional priorities into learning and practical capability.
layers.up: Learners, teachers and research feed new knowledge into institutions.

layers.name: Economy
layers.role: Apply learning to useful products, services, resilient organisations and economic opportunities.
layers.down: Practical competence supports responsible innovation and professional application.
layers.up: Workplace needs and local innovation reshape education and institutions.

layers.name: Society
layers.role: Start with people: their needs, agency, access to knowledge and ability to shape change.
layers.down: Education and economic development should improve everyday participation and opportunity.
layers.up: Human needs and lived experience drive learning, innovation and future capability objectives.

audiences.name: Society
audiences.need: Understand change. Make informed choices. Start learning at your own level.

audiences.name: Schools & Academia
audiences.people: Students, teachers, schools, universities and academic research
audiences.need: Connect learner agency, educator development and practical projects with institutional capacity.

audiences.name: Business & Economy
audiences.need: Build useful AI applications, resilient systems and the competence to evaluate technical choices.

audiences.name: Institutions
audiences.people: Public organisations, NGOs and development institutions
audiences.need: Turn a delivery mandate into accessible learning, accountable projects and sustainable local capacity.

audiences.name: Governments
audiences.people: Ministries, public authorities and national development initiatives
audiences.need: Connect strategic objectives with governance, institutions, education and measurable societal outcomes.

capabilities.name: Human Agency & Digital Literacy
capabilities.question: How do people retain judgement and make informed digital choices?

capabilities.name: Artificial Intelligence
capabilities.question: How can we understand, guide, verify and apply AI?

capabilities.name: Cybersecurity & Cyber Resilience
capabilities.question: How do we protect systems and prepare to respond and recover?

capabilities.name: Systems Architecture
capabilities.question: How do components, data, people and controls work as a coherent system?

capabilities.name: Bitcoin, Blockchain & Web3
capabilities.question: When does a distributed ledger help, and what are its trade-offs?

capabilities.name: IoT, Robotics & Smart Infrastructure
capabilities.question: How can connected physical systems be useful, secure and maintainable?

capabilities.name: Governance, Law & Accountability
capabilities.question: Who decides, who is responsible, and how are decisions reviewed?

capabilities.name: Sustainable Development Goals & Technology
capabilities.question: Which local needs can technology address, and how will benefits be evaluated?

capabilities.name: Teacher Development
capabilities.question: How can educators integrate AI while preserving learning and agency?

capabilities.name: Train-the-Trainer
capabilities.question: How can demonstrated competence become responsible teaching capacity?

capabilities.name: Local & National Capability
capabilities.question: How can people and institutions sustain capability independently?

modules.title: Human judgement and digital literacy
topics: Frame a need before choosing a tool
Distinguish claims, evidence and uncertainty
Consider access, privacy and effects on people
modules.evidence: A decision journal explaining when to use technology and when human judgement should lead.

modules.title: Understand, guide, verify and apply AI
topics: Define a practical use case
Structure instructions and contextual information
Test outputs against evidence and limitations
Document a workflow or prototype
modules.evidence: A use case, tested instructions, quality checklist and practical workflow.

modules.title: Cyber resilience and secure operation
topics: Map assets, trust boundaries and relevant threats
Review identity, least privilege and data access
Plan secure configuration, patching and monitoring
Develop an incident response and recovery exercise
modules.evidence: A threat model, prioritised control plan and tabletop incident exercise.

modules.title: Architecture and system integration
topics: Capture functional and operational requirements
Map data flows, interfaces and system boundaries
Compare integration and deployment alternatives
Define evaluation, observability and change controls
modules.evidence: An architecture diagram, decision records and an evaluation plan.

modules.title: Bitcoin and distributed systems
topics: Transactions, UTXO and verification
Keys, custody and operational risk
Consensus and trust assumptions
Compare ledger and non-ledger approaches to a use case
modules.evidence: A documented transaction model and a reasoned architecture comparison; not investment advice.

modules.title: Connected infrastructure
topics: Sensors, actuators and data flows
Connectivity, edge processing and integration
Physical safety, security and maintenance
Define a prototype and test its operating constraints
modules.evidence: A system map and prototype test plan; equipment requirements are agreed before delivery.

modules.title: Governance and accountability
topics: Assign decision rights and accountable owners
Map data use, affected stakeholders and risks
Define human oversight, escalation and review
Maintain decision records and a process for regulatory review
modules.evidence: A responsibility map, risk register and review procedure. Jurisdiction-specific legal advice is outside this outline.

modules.title: Technology and sustainable development
topics: Identify a local need with affected communities
Relate intended outcomes to relevant SDGs
Assess access, language, cost and resource constraints
Set a baseline and evaluate benefits and unintended effects
modules.evidence: A local problem statement, outcome indicators and an evaluation plan; no UN affiliation implied.

modules.title: Educator practice
topics: Define learning goals before selecting AI activities
Design tasks that preserve learner thinking
Review safeguarding, inclusion and assessment integrity
Reflect on classroom use with educators
modules.evidence: A lesson concept, learner safeguards and a reflection plan.

modules.title: Facilitation and supervised teaching
topics: Translate subject competence into learning activities
Adapt delivery to language and prior knowledge
Practise feedback and evidence-based assessment
Plan observed teaching and quality review
modules.evidence: A training plan and observed-teaching rubric; trainer authorisation requires a separate approved process.

modules.title: Institutional delivery and local ownership
topics: Assess readiness, partners and local infrastructure
Agree delivery ownership and resources
Combine education, projects and trainer development
Define milestones for locally sustained delivery
modules.evidence: A readiness baseline, staged implementation plan and local ownership criteria.

aicademy.need: Move beyond tool familiarity to critical, practical AI use.

labs.need: Turn a defined problem into a reviewable practical result.

bootcamp.need: Bring a cohort together to practise technical work with structured feedback.

architecture.need: Connect technical implementation with security, evaluation and organisational responsibility.

teachers.need: Equip educators to make informed classroom choices without surrendering teacher or learner judgement.

trainers.need: Develop local teaching capacity that can be observed, supported and quality-assured.

local.need: Sustain practical education and delivery beyond an initial workshop.

national.need: Coordinate multiple local pathways within an accountable institutional development programme.

progression.name: Foundation Learning
progression.evidence: Explain concepts, limitations and responsible choices.
progression.contributors: Roots2AI supports human agency; AIcademy develops practical AI understanding.

progression.name: Practical Application
progression.evidence: Apply learning to a defined, locally relevant problem.
progression.contributors: AIcademy, SWE Labs and SWEX.AI technical expertise connect knowledge with practice.

progression.name: Competence Demonstration
progression.evidence: Present an output, tests, decisions and limitations for review.
progression.contributors: AIcademy assessment and agreed SWE project review make learning visible.

progression.name: Professional Opportunities
progression.evidence: Match demonstrated competence and qualifications with an actual opportunity.
progression.contributors: SWE, SWEX.AI and Roots2AI may have trainer, mentor, project or coordination needs.

progression.name: Local Leadership
progression.evidence: Support others, coordinate delivery and review quality.
progression.contributors: SWE Train-the-Trainer and local programme design connect teaching with ownership.

progression.name: Independent Capability
progression.evidence: Apply, adapt, teach and sustain capability without permanent trainer dependence.
progression.contributors: Local and National Capability bring multiple learning and delivery pathways together.
